7. Āśreṣās or Āśleṣās, which in some texts is certainly to be read Aśreṣās or Aśleṣas, denotes , and perhaps also , Hydræ. The word means ‘embracer,’ a name which admirably fits the constellation.
Foot notes Aśreṣās, śāṅkhāyana gṛhya sūtra, i. 26; Śāntikalpa; Nakṣatrakalpa; Aśleṣās, Śāntikalpa, 2; Nakṣatrakalpa, 4. 48.
